mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods following months with FEDFUNDS below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods following months with UNRATE below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic growth and consumer confidence, jointly driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of GDPC1 and HOUST on SPX 20-day returns is not significant (p>0.05) or fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 2.0% annual rate) signals sustained accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods following months with CPIAUCSL (YoY) below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS above 100k monthly) indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods following months with PAYEMS growth above 100k.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100.0) signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods following months with INDPRO below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth (RSAFS above 0.5% monthly) indicates robust consumer spending that drives corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods following months with RSAFS growth above 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in federal funds rate above 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods following months with FEDFUNDS above 0.5%.
